scope: Go2 EDU model in existing Isaac Lab; paper-corresponding stair dimensions plus moderate geometry variation, both ascent and descent
user_authorization: 2026-10-12: prioritize paper-consistent algorithm, mainly adjust rewards; extreme stairs need not be required; stop early if adequate after evidence review
old_global_acceptance_remains: All historical verdicts including night2 selected final remain unchanged; oldfinal is now known diagnostic and not fresh holdout.

algorithm_invariants.algorithm: released HIM with HIMPPO and contrastive estimator; no new teacher, map-conditioned actor or planner
algorithm_invariants.reward_preference: single small reward-weight/term change first; same reset, command, terrain, optimizer and environment-step budget when attributing reward effects
algorithm_invariants.exact_training_updates: root records measured saved updates and environment steps per candidate; not fixed by this evaluation plan

paper_reference.short_real_world: A1: two sets of five stairs, 0.16m rise/0.27m tread, 100% over 20 trials
paper_reference.long_real_world: Aliengo: hundreds of stairs, 0.17m rise/0.25m tread, 176.5 +/- 7.81 stairs over 20 trials
paper_reference.comparison_limit: Five/six/twelve-riser Go2 simulation matches selected dimensions and one five-riser flight, not original robot/software, two-flight short setup or hundreds-step real-world result; no direct numerical superiority claim

development.purpose: Existing night2 development set reused for newround3 reward tuning; oldnight2final may be referenced only as known diagnostic

final.purpose: Round3 after new candidate/source/gate freeze only; six shared known paper core plus10newexactgeometry combinations
final.novelty_limit: Ten exact combinations disjoint from old development/final; training range interpolation and12steplength extrapolation, not unseen distribution, all share same straight-stair generator.

evaluation.construction_seed_scope: fixed deterministic geometry and nominal dynamics; three reset seeds do not mean three training seeds or three randomized construction scenes

controllers.primary: default external root-yaw feedback: yaw-rate=clamp(-yaw,-0.5,0.5)rad/s, target0; no external lateral correction
controllers.mandatory_report: same cases/seeds/speeds with --open_loop_heading (constant zero yaw command); no external root-yaw correction
controllers.claim_limit_if_zero_yaw_fails: successful under declared heading feedback; actor-only global-heading/smooth traversal not established

evaluation.source_assess_final_gate: 95% completion / <=5% fall-stall-escape / zero base contact; does not implement new strict core fall or numerical roll gates
evaluation.source_exit_code_zero_means: collection/export completed; not traversal or smoothness acceptance

quality_evidence.comparison_scope: Only compare competent traversal at equal case/speed/seed/controller and matching physical readbacks; failed/short episodes cannot win by lower motion magnitude
quality_evidence.unqualified_smooth_wording: requires completion of source-specific video review plus numerical screen and failure-free recorded episodes; report population failures separately

acceptance.paper_short_success_reference: Aim for observed 100% completion in core simulation; practical95% acceptance alone cannot be described as matching the paper's100% result

required: selected reward profile and effective weights
source Git commit and source hashes
selection based only on development results
candidate_freeze.after_final_failure: Keep round3 failure; no selection/retuning on round3 reserved evidence. A later round would require another explicitly fresh protocol.

flat_regression.scope: Selected stair checkpoint, ordinary actor/HIM inference on plane with explicit reset transfer for235-to48 critic shape if needed; no training updates
flat_regression.claim_limit: Flat all-direction failures must stay visible; stair success does not imply general locomotion reproduction

video.selection_rule_before_render: Each direction and speed on both core dimensions, with five-riser16/27 included in at least one speed; additionally one moderate nosing pair and one long pair. Choose declared representative successful env, plus any failing/most-paused case where available; preserve all metrics

optional_robustness.geometry_subset: predeclare core pairs plus one moderate nosing pair; do not extrapolate to the full set
optional_robustness.material_sensitivity: basic domain with fresh matched nominal foot-friction scene0.8/0.6, then0.6/0.45 and1.0/0.8; source USD readback required; other randomized events removed
optional_robustness.combined_dynamics: separate optional report; never required to overturn current declared nominal success and never substitute for nominal evidence

optional_paper_long_progress.scope: long-flight progress diagnostic; nominal Go2 simulation, not matching original Aliengo real-world176.5-step score
optional_paper_long_progress.progress_limit: Root directed progress and risers-passed estimates cannot replace full four-foot goal dwell completion; keep failures, completion times, pause and abnormal-state flags

requires: development-core and moderate no critical unresolved failures
completed final mandatory controller/speed/reset matrices or explicit narrowed verified claim
